0.0: Olive claimed to be innocent. That's something the other Job Instructors and I will have to discuss. But this letter is certain enlightening.
0.1: Thank you. I will talk to the Dark Lord about this matter. The truth will come to light in time.

no.0: Was there more? I'm sure I'll call upon you again soon, so please rest up.

yes.0: I would hate for a fellow Explorer to be framed.
yes.1: Thank you again for delivering the letter.
